baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three call forms at words 2, 5, and 23, the response verb at 9, and the right/real qualifier at 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: A call opens an exchange and an answer closes it by returning speech or effect. Reality-grounded address has a respondent, while address aimed at an alternative target remains open.

activation_trace.role: Calling and attracting by speech supplies the initiating address repeated across the ayah.
Stable correspondence with reality distinguishes the grounded address from empty alternatives.
Otherness marks the substituted addressee that cannot complete the exchange.
Returned speech and response supply the reciprocal half missing from the rival calls.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely contrasts true prayer with unanswered false prayer.
changed_reading.after: The ayah models invocation as reciprocal address: one reality-grounded call has a respondent, while rival addresses never close the exchange.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The extended palms, water, doubled reaching language, and mouth at words 13-21.
baseline_models.mechanism: Extension supplies posture and range, not transport. The palms neither contact nor convey the water, so the desired material cannot reach the mouth; the doubled reach root makes failed delivery the image's hinge.

activation_trace.role: Extending the hand supplies visible effort without itself creating transfer.
The literal palms are the bodily instrument placed between seeker and water.
The begging hand makes the extension a request posture rather than a working conduit.
Actual water is the material sought, keeping the mechanism concrete rather than purely verbal.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the required but unrealized movement to the mouth.
The open mouth is the fixed destination against which failed arrival is measured.

changed_reading.before: The water image is only a generic picture of an impossible wish.
changed_reading.after: It diagnoses a missing transfer mechanism: desire, posture, and proximity do not cause a resource to traverse the gap to its user.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compact pairing of call and right at words 2-3, followed by rival calling and denial of any thing at 5-11.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call can also function as a claim or asserted entitlement. The opening grants an established right, while the rivals assert claims against substitutes that own no enforceable counter-obligation or deliverable.

activation_trace.role: Claiming a right or affiliation turns invocation into an asserted entitlement.
A specific right held by its owner supplies the legal substance of the opening claim.
Competing parties each claiming right frames the rival calls as a contest of warrants.
A knowable, reportable thing serves as the concrete performance that no rival claim can obtain.

changed_reading.before: The qualifier describes the sincerity or correctness of a devotional act.
changed_reading.after: It can mark the only valid and enforceable claim, against rival assertions that lack both a responsible counterparty and any deliverable effect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Call, answer, mouth, repeated reaching, and loss language across words 2-27.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mouth emits an address, but an answer must cross a route and arrive. With no receptive destination or traversable channel, the signal and its sought return disappear rather than merely receiving a negative reply.

activation_trace.role: Opening the mouth in speech supplies the signal's point of emission.
Vocal address launches the attempted communication.
Crossing land or distance gives response a traversal dimension beyond verbal echo.
Message delivery supplies the requirement that an address reach a receiver.
Disappearance and obscurity render the unanswered call as a signal lost from view.
Loss of a thing from its owner supplies the failed-delivery endpoint of the communication model.

changed_reading.before: Being in error names only the callers' false belief.
changed_reading.after: It also renders their prayer as lost transmission: emitted speech never finds a receiver, route, or returning effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revelation as truth and water are both delivered from a source; clouds are drawn, water is routed through measured valleys, and provision is spread by God. The hand image now contrasts receptivity to allocated delivery with trying to manufacture arrival by posture.

activation_trace.role: The extended hand supplies the upward acquisition gesture that context will reverse.
The begging palm marks request without causal control of supply.
Causing something to descend and arrive makes revealed truth a delivered gift rather than a seized object.
Reality-matching stability identifies what descends as the same quality attached to the focus call.
Drawing and extending supplies the effective agency that moves the heavy cloud, contrasting with inert hand extension.
Delivered descent now carries literal water into the material mechanism.
The repeated material water directly reopens the focus image in a working supply system.
A valley as a flood channel supplies the conduit absent from the bare hand gesture.
A measure that reaches its limit makes channel capacity govern how much flow arrives.
Spreading and enlarging provision relocates effective extension from the petitioner's hand to divine allocation.
An apportioned gift makes supply assigned rather than mechanically pulled into reach.

structural_cues: The sequence repeats delivered truth at 13:1, drawn clouds at 13:12, descended water at 13:17, and divine spreading of provision at 13:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, drawing, measured channels, and allocation; I infer that these are the causal route missing from the hand gesture. The live alternative is that the focus remains only an impossibility simile without a general supply model.

changed_reading.before: The petitioner simply reaches for an unavailable object.
changed_reading.after: The contrast is between receiving a truth or provision through its source-governed route and trying to force arrival through an empty acquisition posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet alternates concrete thing and willing under one focus root inventory, while measure, ownership, erasure, and establishment remain divine. Answering with any thing becomes the production of an effect, not merely an audible reply.

activation_trace.role: The indefinite thing is the concrete or reportable effect explicitly denied to the rival responders.
Verbal response supplies the narrower reading that the context expands into efficacy.
Every knowable thing being present under measure relocates concrete effects to divine governance.
Bounded measure gives each effect an assigned limit rather than leaving it to a rival caller's demand.
Ownership with power of disposal names the capacity explicitly absent from alternative patrons.
The repeated totality of things places the focus denial inside a comprehensive field of created effects.
Willing attached to a thing activates the transition from intention to produced or encountered effect.
The same will-related branch governs selection between removal and establishment.
Erasing an effect supplies one concrete direction of efficacious response.
Making an effect endure supplies the opposite concrete direction of efficacious response.

structural_cues: Across 13:8, 13:16, 13:26, and 13:39, the same focus root alternates between a concrete thing and willing while effects are measured, owned, removed, or established.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared root inventory and the repeated effect-governing sequence; I infer that the denied thing is instantiated efficacy. The live alternative is emphatic indefiniteness, with the thing and will senses doing no mechanistic work together.

changed_reading.before: The alternatives do not return even a word or minimal reply.
changed_reading.after: They cannot turn desire into any bounded, owned, or enduring effect; their failure is ontological production, not only silence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Concealed and declared speech are equally exposed in 13:10, while 13:16 denies alternative patrons ownership of benefit or harm. The focus nonresponse therefore shifts from a hearing problem to incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Vocal address poses the initial possibility that failure is acoustic.
Returned speech supplies the apparently acoustic answer frame.
Any concrete thing opens the response beyond words into practical effect.
Speech hidden inwardly remains within the context's field of access.
Declared and raised speech supplies the audible pole made equivalent to concealment.
Lack of ownership and disposal identifies the rivals' actual functional deficit.
Benefit names the positive effect an able respondent would have to control.
Harm or diminution names the negative effect likewise outside the rivals' control.

structural_cues: The sequence neutralizes the secret-versus-loud distinction at 13:10 before explicitly denying rival ownership of benefit and harm at 13:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equal access to hidden and public speech plus lack of rival ownership; I infer that 13:16 explains 13:14's silence as incapacity. The live alternative is that these are parallel claims with no explanatory arrow.

changed_reading.before: The invoked alternatives fail because the call does not get heard or verbally returned.
changed_reading.after: Volume and concealment are irrelevant; the alternatives fail because they have no dispositional control over any beneficial or harmful outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 13:18 humans become the responders, and 13:21-25 render fidelity as maintaining or severing commanded connections. The focus complaint about an unanswered call is mirrored by the callers' own response or nonresponse within a relational circuit.

activation_trace.role: Response to speech initially places humans on the asking side of the exchange.
The same reply branch reverses grammatical agency so humans answer or refuse their Lord.
Continuing relation without estrangement gives sustained response a social form.
Reaching a destination links ethical connection to the focus problem of arrival.
Severing connection supplies the active counterpart to nonresponse.
The repeated demanded connection restates reaching as a maintained relation rather than a one-way request.

structural_cues: The answer verb reverses subject and object at 13:18, followed by a paired sequence of keeping and cutting connections in 13:20-25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical reversal and the connection-versus-cut sequence; I infer a reciprocal response circuit. The live alternative is a narrower moral analogy in which the covenant material does not explain invocation.

changed_reading.before: People ask and divine or rival powers occupy only the answering position.
changed_reading.after: Invocation is reciprocal: the human also stands under a call, and severed response on the human side mirrors the dead circuit encountered when calling substitutes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance and repeated return culminate in 13:36 pairing calling toward God with return toward the same destination. The focus contrast between a short-of-goal substitute and failed reaching becomes directional rather than merely classificatory.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that stops short of the goal turns the substitute into a premature endpoint.
Arrival at the goal supplies the directional test for a call's route.
Deviation from path names the failed vector rather than only a false proposition.
The repeated path deviation places the focus loss inside an explicit guidance contrast.
Habitual return supplies the corrective motion opposed to deviation.
Calling toward a named destination makes invocation an oriented movement.
Return to a destination gives the call a matching terminal movement.
A direction from which one comes makes return and call share a spatial axis.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from deviation versus guidance and returning at 13:27 to the compact call-and-return pairing at 13:36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shortfall, path deviation, return, and the same destination for call and return; I infer a directional mechanism. The live alternative is that return names only final destiny and does not govern prayer's efficacy.

changed_reading.before: Calling others is wrong because the targets belong to the wrong class.
changed_reading.after: Calling is a trajectory: stopping at a substitute short of the source prevents both arrival and return, while the viable call and the final return share one destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to name the partners, the challenge of unknown referents, and the description of outward speech sharpen the baseline claim model. Rival invocation can be grammatically formed yet lack a reality-grounded addressee.

activation_trace.role: An asserted claim or affiliation supplies the rival invocation's social force.
Correspondence with stable reality supplies the criterion missing from rival naming.
A name as indication requires a referent and exposes the challenge to identify the alleged partners.
Saying or attributing what is not supplies the mechanism of verbally manufactured partners.
Surface appearance confines the rival account to exposed wording without depth.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the reality test that the alleged referents fail.

structural_cues: The single challenge in 13:33 moves from naming, to informing of an unknown referent, to outward speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a naming-and-knowledge test followed by surface speech; I infer that referential failure explains nonresponse. The live alternative is that the passage attacks authorization rather than the partners' referential status.

changed_reading.before: Rival prayer is a meaningful address directed to the wrong beings.
changed_reading.after: It may be polished address without a grounded addressee: names and claims circulate at the surface, but nothing answerable stands behind them.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 13:40 conveying and reckoning are assigned to different sides. The focus's repeated reaching no longer implies that the speaker or petitioner controls reception and outcome: delivery can be a bounded duty while effect belongs elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Physical arrival supplies the focus demand that the desired effect reach its endpoint.
Message delivery opens a second reach model in which transmission and outcome can be separated.
Reply remains the receiver-side event that a sender cannot manufacture.
Assigned conveyance makes delivery a limited responsibility rather than control of response.
Counting and reckoning place outcome and accountability on the other side of the boundary.

structural_cues: The two balanced clauses of 13:40 assign conveying and accounting to different agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit division of roles; I infer that it clarifies the focus distinction between sending, arrival, and response. The live alternative is that messenger duty and petitionary efficacy remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: Failure to reach means only that the petitioner's effort is too weak.
changed_reading.after: The ayah also exposes a category error about agency: one may send or convey, but cannot force reception, reply, or the accounted outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses non-dominant packet mappings for the response root rather than its ordinary reply sense. It remains anchored by the focus water, mouth, and reaching image and by the later valley channel; downstream prose should present it only as a hydraulic activation, not as a lexical translation of the response verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The response verb at 9 sits inside a hand-water-mouth transport image at words 13-21.

activation_trace.role: Collected water in a large basin turns response into an image of accessible stored supply.
A cut, unlined well supplies the cavity or access route that the false respondent cannot form.
Literal water keeps the split-root reservoir images attached to the focus scene.
A river mouth or outlet lets the bodily mouth function as a hydraulic destination.
A valley watercourse supplies the later working channel against which the focus lacks access.

changed_reading.before: An answer is only returned speech or granted effect.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, an answer is also the formation of a reservoir, opening, or channel that makes supply accessible; the substitutes produce none.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is form-distant because it relies on the packet's secondary mapping from the torrent root to asking. It remains worth carrying because 13:17 combines water flow, measured channels, floating foam, and persistence immediately around the focus water-call mechanism; render it as cross-root wordplay and process analogy, not direct semantics.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins repeated calling, water, failed response, and loss.

activation_trace.role: Calling and asking supplies the petitionary process to be recast as flow.
Literal water anchors the context torrent to the focus image.
Torrent flow supplies the moving material process through the valleys.
The split mapping to asking overlays petition onto the flowing torrent.
Measured capacity determines how much of the petition-flow a channel can bear.
Floating foam supplies transient surface output that resembles an impressive but empty request.
Lasting with patience supplies the contrasting criterion of durable benefit.

changed_reading.before: Each prayer is a discrete utterance that either receives an answer or does not.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, petitions behave like flows shaped by channel capacity, with froth-like surface demand passing away while useful effect remains.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is surprising because it activates the water-route branch of a context root used for being turned away. It remains anchored by the focus water, failed reaching, and path-loss language, plus the explicit path sequence at 13:33; downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial-material overlay rather than claim that the path literally denotes water here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Water at 16 cannot reach the mouth, and the final loss term can denote deviation from a path.

activation_trace.role: Water supplies the desired endpoint for the route model.
Failure to arrive supplies the route's broken outcome.
Deviation from the intended path names the focus failure spatially.
A route to water hidden inside the turning-away inventory gives the blockage a precise material target.
An extended traversable way supplies the route from source to destination.
Repeated deviation confirms that the blocked way and the focus loss share a directional failure.

changed_reading.before: The call is abstractly misguided and therefore useless.
changed_reading.after: It can also be pictured as diverted from the actual water-route: the resource is present, but the path that would carry it to the mouth is blocked.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the packet's bidirectional split between the palm and sufficiency inventories, not on a surface-level etymology. It remains anchored by the exact focus palm and the final sufficiency statement; downstream prose should render it as latent wordplay contrasting instrument and sufficient agent, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two palms at word 14 are extended in need but achieve no delivery.

activation_trace.role: The outstretched begging palm supplies visible insufficiency and dependence.
The split target's adequate performance imports sufficiency as a latent counter-image to the failed hand.
Full sufficiency in carrying an affair relocates adequacy from the petitioner's instrument to God.
The reverse mapping recalls the asking palm inside the final declaration of sufficiency.

changed_reading.before: The palms are only ineffective tools reaching for water.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their emptiness stages insufficiency, while the surah's close identifies sufficiency with the true agent rather than the grasping instrument.

strongest_changes: The hand-water image became a contrast between source-governed descent through measured channels and posture without causal transport.
The answer verb reversed at 13:18, making human response and maintained connection part of the focus's reciprocal circuit.
The denied thing became instantiated efficacy under measure, ownership, willing, erasure, and establishment rather than merely a missing verbal reply.
Calling and return converged on one destination, while 13:40 separated bounded delivery from control of reception and outcome.
summary.what_was_special: Split-root inventories made the latent material structure unusually dense: response opened toward reservoirs and wells, torrent toward asking, a barred path toward water access, and the palm toward sufficiency. These readings coexist with the stronger speech, claim, transport, and agency models rather than replacing them.
remaining_uncertainties: The thing-to-willing linkage may be a live productive mechanism or only a packet-supported association between ordinary senses.
The hydraulic split-root readings are strongly image-aligned but remain too form-distant to state as lexical meanings.
The covenant connection sequence may explain reciprocal invocation causally, or may only echo it as a neighboring ethical pattern.
